name: Silly Dance Song
body:
Your song causes those that hear it to get up and move to the beat…whether they want to or not!

Prerequisite(s): Bard 6

Benefit: Whenever you use your bardic performance, choose a number of enemies that you’re facing equal to one-third your bard level (rounded down). Those that you choose start to dance and flail about uncontrollably to the rhythm of your tune (no save). The targets of this feat get a -2 to armor class and a -5 to reflex saves. Any armor bonus the target receives because of a shield he holds is negated.
